messages:
Maya (PM): Heads up — Catalyst reported a 2-5x tail latency regression on text-generation since last night's runtime deploy. Marking for immediate intake and prioritization. See support summary below.

Liam (support): From the ticket: p50 ~120ms, p95 jumped from ~290ms -> ~1.1s for short prompts (~32 tokens). They attached request IDs: r-17a2, r-17b8, r-17c4. No config changes on their side. Customer observed spikes at 14:10 and 16:30 UTC.

Anita (sales): Catalyst is on an enterprise SLA (reserved capacity). They're asking for an interim mitigation and a timeline — high priority. They mentioned they'd pay for a short Dedicated burst window if that speeds recovery.

Zoe (CS): Confirming: Catalyst expects <200ms p95 for the short prompt path in their contract. They're very sensitive to degradation because it's in-prod search enrichment.

Omar (eng-runtime): On it. Quick questions: a) can support paste the annotated trace link (span ids) and one raw request payload? b) we can attempt immediate mitigation: 1) pin routing to low-latency variant (v1.9-q8) 2) temporarily disable batching for that customer 3) scale their pool + increase max concurrency. Which do we want to try first?

Liam (support): Trace link + sample request posted to ticket: https://redwood/support/tickets/CA-3821 -> trace r-17b8. Sample payload: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -H 'X-Request-ID: r-17b8' -d '{"prompt":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":32}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```

deploy-bot: deploy 2025-06-03T02:12Z -> inference-runtime v4.2.1 (rollout: canary -> 25%).

Omar (eng-runtime): That matches timeline. v4.2.1 introduced a new KV-cache shard change that can increase hot-path locking under certain sequence-length distributions. Action plan (short): - step A (now): route Catalyst to v1.9-q8 low-latency variant + disable batching for their tenant (expected immediate p95 improvement). - step B (next 24h): increase pool for their reserved capacity and monitor. - step C (48-72h): full root-cause RCA + patch (likely kernel lock reduction or shard tuning).

Maya (PM): Proposal: create an intake ticket in product backlog labeled "inc: catalyst latency - urgent" with acceptance criteria: (1) p95 for short prompts <300ms sustained for 2 hours, (2) deployment mitigation documented, (3) RCA draft within 5 days. Target to ship mitigation in 48h. Owners: Omar (eng-runtime), Zoe (CS), Liam (support), Anita (sales), Maya (PM).

Anita (sales): Need an explicit timeline to give Catalyst. If step A + B are quick, they want the Dedicated burst today. Sales will confirm budget.

Omar (eng-runtime): I'll run step A now. Liam please confirm tenant id and I'll post the routing change request here. Also I'll add smoke checks: `curl /internal/health?tenant=catalyst` and `curl /internal/trace?r=r-17b8` to pull spans.

Liam (support): Tenant id: catalyst-prod-01. Executed routing request to ops: `@ops please route catalyst-prod-01 -> v1.9-q8` (ticket OPS-9123).

deploy-bot: ops change OPS-9123 applied at 1767555400.

Omar (eng-runtime): Verified 5 minutes after ops change: p95 for sampled requests back to ~250-280ms. I'm running a 30m elevated sampling window and will keep dashboard open.

Zoe (CS): Customer notified: we applied a mitigation and are monitoring; they asked for a short post-mortem and final timeline.

Maya (PM): Ok — we'll log the intake into the product backlog now and mark as P0 for next 48h. Negotiation note: if the permanent fix requires runtime kernel changes that risk broader rollout, we should scope an isolated patch for Catalyst then a broader follow-up. Sales, please confirm whether they prefer a hotfix + rollback-safe patch vs waiting for full runtime release.

Anita (sales): I'll confirm with the customer; leaning hotfix + rollback-safe patch. They want SLA credits if not restored to contract within 48h.

Maya (PM): Final: backlog ticket created (PROD-5832). Acceptance criteria restated in ticket. Next steps: Omar -> implement patch plan & timeline; Liam -> keep ticket updates and collect traces; Zoe -> customer comms; Anita -> finalize Dedicated burst purchase if requested. We'll reconvene in 2 hours for status. :thumbsup:

Omar (eng-runtime): Acknowledged. Starting RCA.

Liam (support): I'll paste additional request IDs as they come in.

Zoe (CS): Noted. I'll send the customer the mitigation summary and ETA.

Maya (PM): Thanks everyone.
